SELECT COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount), 0) FROM wms_sales_out so WHERE so.del_flag = '0' AND so.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND so.approve_by IS NOT NULL AND so.approve_by != '' AND DATE(so.create_time) = CURDATE()
AND so.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}

AND sr.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}

AND so.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}

AND pr.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}

SELECT
t.report_date AS reportDate, NULL AS customerId, '全部' AS customerName, NULL AS warehouseId, '全部' AS warehouseName
t.report_date AS reportDate, t.customer_id AS customerId, COALESCE(c.customer_name, '未知') AS customerName, NULL AS warehouseId, '全部' AS warehouseName
t.report_date AS reportDate, NULL AS customerId, '全部' AS customerName, t.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, COALESCE(w.warehouse_name, '全部') AS warehouseName
t.report_date AS reportDate, t.customer_id AS customerId, COALESCE(c.customer_name, '未知') AS customerName, t.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, COALESCE(w.warehouse_name, '全部') AS warehouseName
NULL AS reportDate, t.customer_id AS customerId, COALESCE(c.customer_name, '未知') AS customerName, NULL AS warehouseId, '全部' AS warehouseName
NULL AS reportDate, NULL AS customerId, '全部' AS customerName, t.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, COALESCE(w.warehouse_name, '全部') AS warehouseName
NULL AS reportDate, t.customer_id AS customerId, COALESCE(c.customer_name, '未知') AS customerName, t.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, COALESCE(w.warehouse_name, '全部') AS warehouseName
t.report_date AS reportDate, NULL AS customerId, '全部' AS customerName, NULL AS warehouseId, '全部' AS warehouseName
, COALESCE(SUM(t.order_count), 0) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(t.order_amount), 0) AS orderAmount, COALESCE(SUM(t.out_count), 0) AS outCount, COALESCE(SUM(t.out_amount), 0) AS outAmount, COALESCE(SUM(t.return_count), 0) AS returnCount, COALESCE(SUM(t.return_amount), 0) AS returnAmount, COALESCE(SUM(t.out_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(t.return_amount), 0) AS netSales FROM ( -- 销售订单（当未选择仓库筛选时才统计） SELECT DATE(so.create_time) AS report_date, so.customer_id, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS warehouse_id, COUNT(DISTINCT so.id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount), 0) AS order_amount, 0 AS out_count, 0 AS out_amount, 0 AS return_count, 0 AS return_amount FROM wms_sales_order so WHERE so.del_flag = 0
AND DATE(so.create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND DATE(so.create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
AND so.customer_id IN
#{id}
AND 1 = 0
GROUP BY DATE(so.create_time), so.customer_id
UNION ALL
-- 销售出库（只关联有效仓库） SELECT DATE(sout.create_time) AS report_date, sout.customer_id, sout.warehouse_id, 0 AS order_count, 0 AS order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT sout.id) AS out_count, COALESCE(SUM(sout.total_amount), 0) AS out_amount, 0 AS return_count, 0 AS return_amount FROM wms_sales_out sout INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w ON sout.warehouse_id = w.id AND w.del_flag = '0' WHERE sout.del_flag = 0
AND DATE(sout.create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND DATE(sout.create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
AND sout.customer_id IN
#{id}
AND sout.warehouse_id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY DATE(sout.create_time), sout.customer_id, sout.warehouse_id
UNION ALL
-- 销售退货（只关联有效仓库） SELECT DATE(sr.create_time) AS report_date, sr.customer_id, sr.warehouse_id, 0 AS order_count, 0 AS order_amount, 0 AS out_count, 0 AS out_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.id) AS return_count, COALESCE(SUM(sr.total_amount), 0) AS return_amount FROM wms_sales_return sr INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w ON sr.warehouse_id = w.id AND w.del_flag = '0' WHERE sr.del_flag = 0
AND DATE(sr.create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND DATE(sr.create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
AND sr.customer_id IN
#{id}
AND sr.warehouse_id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY DATE(sr.create_time), sr.customer_id, sr.warehouse_id ) t LEFT JOIN wms_customer c ON t.customer_id = c.id AND c.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON t.warehouse_id = w.id AND w.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY
t.report_date
t.report_date, t.customer_id, c.customer_name
t.report_date, t.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name
t.report_date, t.customer_id, c.customer_name, t.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name
t.customer_id, c.customer_name
t.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name
t.customer_id, c.customer_name, t.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name
t.report_date
ORDER BY
t.report_date DESC
t.report_date DESC, c.customer_name
t.report_date DESC, w.warehouse_name
t.report_date DESC, c.customer_name, w.warehouse_name
c.customer_name
w.warehouse_name
c.customer_name, w.warehouse_name
t.report_date DESC

SELECT @rownum := @rownum + 1 AS rankNo, t.goodsCode, t.goodsName, t.spec, t.unit, t.categoryName, t.warehouseName, t.saleQuantity, t.saleAmount, t.costAmount, t.profitAmount, t.profitRate FROM ( SELECT sku.sku_code AS goodsCode, COALESCE(spu.goods_name, sku.sku_name) AS goodsName, sku.spec_info AS spec, sku.unit_name AS unit,
cat.category_name AS categoryName,
NULL AS categoryName,
w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName,
NULL AS warehouseName,
SUM(sout_item.quantity) AS saleQuantity, SUM(sout_item.amount) AS saleAmount, SUM(sout_item.quantity * COALESCE(sku.cost_price, 0)) AS costAmount, SUM(sout_item.amount - sout_item.quantity * COALESCE(sku.cost_price, 0)) AS profitAmount, CASE WHEN SUM(sout_item.amount) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(sout_item.amount - sout_item.quantity * COALESCE(sku.cost_price, 0)) / SUM(sout_item.amount)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS profitRate FROM wms_sales_out_item sout_item INNER JOIN wms_sales_out sout ON sout_item.out_id = sout.id INNER JOIN wms_goods_sku sku ON sout_item.sku_id = sku.id INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w ON sout.warehouse_id = w.id AND w.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN wms_goods spu ON sku.goods_id = spu.id
LEFT JOIN wms_goods_category cat ON spu.category_id = cat.id
WHERE sout.del_flag = 0
AND DATE(sout.create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND DATE(sout.create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
AND spu.category_id IN
#{id}
AND sout.warehouse_id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY sku.sku_code, sku.sku_name, spu.goods_name, sku.spec_info, sku.unit_name
, cat.category_name
, w.warehouse_name
ORDER BY
SUM(sout_item.quantity) DESC
SUM(sout_item.amount - sout_item.quantity * COALESCE(sku.cost_price, 0)) DESC
SUM(sout_item.amount) DESC
LIMIT 100 ) t, (SELECT @rownum := 0) r
